text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... got a pimple on my forehead.
Guess I'll have to hide it with my bangs...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I've been staying up late drawing manga recently.
Those late-night snacks probably didn't help either.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I really need to fix my lifestyle habits... but still.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I refuse!"
I'm the one who set the deadline to get it completely finished by next week, darn it!

Prioritizing manga over everything else,
Kiseki's rough skin just wouldn't clear up.
